Sandbox_PhunTaxi_Debug_tooltip: Verbose logging for point registration, discovery and spawning
Sandbox_PhunTaxi_UseSpawnRoom_tooltip: If yes, a new character wakes up in the Taxi Garage, an off grid room, and takes one free taxi ride to a place they know. If no, or when there is no room free, they are placed straight at the last place their player chose, or a start point they know
Sandbox_PhunTaxi_DiscoveryRadius_tooltip: How close you have to get to a spawn point that is a place rather than a pay phone before you remember it. There is nothing at a place to pick up, so this cannot be 0. Pay phones have their own range
Sandbox_PhunTaxi_ShowUndiscovered_toolti: If yes, places you have not found are listed greyed out, so the list is somewhere to head for. If no, they are not sent to your client at all
Sandbox_PhunTaxi_AllowBuiltPoints_toolti: If yes, a player may build a pay phone from a crafted kit, for anybody to find and use
Sandbox_PhunTaxi_BuiltPointLimit_tooltip: How many pay phones one player may have standing at once. Set to 0 for no limit
Sandbox_PhunTaxi_RespawnPenalty_tooltip: Not used yet. Reserved for a cost on choosing where to wake up, and has no effect in this version
Sandbox_PhunTaxi_PhoneChance_tooltip: Percent chance a vanilla pay phone is replaced by one that is a spawn point, rolled once per phone the first time it loads. Set to 0 to turn the swap off
Sandbox_PhunTaxi_PhoneDistance_tooltip: No pay phone is replaced within this many squares of one that already has been. Set to 0 for no spacing
Sandbox_PhunTaxi_PhoneRing_tooltip: If yes, a pay phone you have not discovered yet rings now and then while you are near it, so it is easier to notice
Sandbox_PhunTaxi_PhoneRingRange_tooltip: How close, in squares, you have to be for an undiscovered pay phone to ring for you
Sandbox_PhunTaxi_BuiltPhoneDistance_tool: A player cannot build a pay phone within this many squares of any other. Set to 0 for no spacing
Sandbox_PhunTaxi_PhoneDiscoverRadius_too: How close, in squares, you have to get to a pay phone to remember it, and it rings once to say so. Set to 0 and you have to pick the phone up
Sandbox_PhunTaxi_TaxiFastTravel_tooltip: If yes, a player can call a taxi from any pay phone they know to any other, for a fare. The first ride, out of the spawn room, is always free
Sandbox_PhunTaxi_TaxiCentsPerSquare_tool: Cents of PhunMart change per square travelled. Needs PhunMart unless this and the minimum fare are both 0
Sandbox_PhunTaxi_TaxiMinimumFare_tooltip: The least any taxi ride costs, in cents
Sandbox_PhunTaxi_TaxiZombieRadius_toolti: A taxi will not come while a zombie is within this many squares. Set to 0 to turn this off
